model_output.verdict: An experienced pharmacy technician with sterile compounding, hospital restocking, and retail pharmacy work clearly laid out.
write_up: This is a strong pharmacy technician resume! Your move from RiteCare to inpatient pharmacy comes with the work and its scale: sterile doses, nursing units and technicians trained. A recruiter can see both your retail background and your current hospital work.

The cabinet restocking line is a great model. It names the six nursing units and shows stockout reports falling from 9 to 2 per week in 2024, without leaving a recruiter to guess what was measured. Your credentials and job dates are easy to find, too.

Let's sharpen the retail prescription and immunization lines so a pharmacy reviewer can see more of what you handled. Your resume isn't likely to be the thing holding you back on its own; how competitive a particular job is will matter too.
